title: Form 1099-DIV box 1a statement items, tax year 2025
closure_claim: Every total ordinary dividend amount reported in box 1a of a Form 1099-DIV furnished to the taxpayer for tax year 2025 is recorded as a statement item. This claim covers Form 1099-DIV box 1a only: it says nothing about box 1b, the recorded non-composable boxes (2a, 3, 5, 7, 12), dividends not reported on Form 1099-DIV, or total ordinary dividends (Form 1040 line 3b).
